issues.on_page: Schedules 1-2 print both 'Actual on GAAP Basis' and 'Actual on Budgetary Basis'
issues.issue: Extractor used the budgetary-basis actual column (e.g. Engineering 10,888 vs GAAP 7,533; GF warrants issued 46,420 / retired (39,790) not on the GAAP statement). Totals tie on that basis and it is noted, but the choice of Actual column is an assumption.
